articles.description:
Fishbone’s “Party At Ground Zero” Live on KEXP

Fishbone tore through a high-energy version of their ska-punk classic “Party At Ground Zero” in the KEXP studio on August 5, 2025. Led by frontman Angelo Moore (vocals, sax, theremin) alongside Christopher Dowd (trombone, keys, vocals), Tracey “Spacey T” Singleton (guitar), James “Jimi” Jones (bass), Hassan Hurd (drums) and John “JS” Williams II (trumpet, vocals), the band delivers its signature blend of funk, punk and soul.
Hosted by Larry Mizell Jr. and expertly captured by audio engineer Kevin Suggs with mastering by Julian Martlew, the session was filmed by Jim Beckmann, Carlos Cruz, Leah Franks, Scott Holpainen and Luke Knecht (with Beckmann also editing). Dive deeper at fishbone.net and kexp.org.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: KEXP: Fishbone - Party At Ground Zero (Live on KEXP)

articles.description:
The Music Theory of Silksong’s Bone Bottom Theme


8bitMusicTheory breaks down how Hornet’s new Bone Bottom theme (from Hollow Knight: Silksong) stacks up against the classic Dirtmouth tune, spotlighting that mournful flat-six chord, a steadfast chord pattern, and a swooping B-section that bends the key just to keep the harmony tight.  
From 6:16 you’ll hear why sometimes you have to sacrifice the “official” key signature to stick to your favorite chords, and then at 8:50–9:45 you get a head-to-head on how Dirtmouth and Bone Bottom each tug at your heartstrings in their own way.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: 8-Bit Music Theory: The Music Theory of Silksong's Bone Bottom Theme

articles.description:
TL;DR


Europe snuck away with a 15-13 win over the U.S. at a raucous Bethpage Black, fending off a late American comeback. Secret envelope selections and the chaos of unruly fans added drama, and many are still debating how much that “envelope rule” swung the balance.
